stories.title: F1: veja o grid de largada para o GP do Bahrein com Verstappen na pole e Bortoleto em 10º

en.title: F1: see the starting grid for the Bahrain GP with Verstappen on pole and Bortoleto in 10th
en.summary: The starting grid for the Formula 1 Bahrain Grand Prix has been determined, with Verstappen securing pole position and Bortoleto starting from 10th place.

stories.title: Como 'forasteiro' e racha entre aliados elevaram protagonismo da eleição para Senado em SC

en.title: As an 'outsider' and split among allies elevate the prominence of Senate election in SC
en.summary: The Senate election in Santa Catarina gained unprecedented attention this year after Carlos Bolsonaro entered the race, triggering internal divisions within the PL and right-wing alliances in the state.

stories.title: Veja como foi a campanha dos candidatos ao governo de Goiás

en.title: See how the campaign of candidates for governor of Goiás was
en.summary: Candidates Daniel Vilela, Marconi Perillo, Wilder Morais, and Luis César Bueno campaigned for the Goiás governorship since August, presenting proposals on health, education, technology, and public security.

stories.title: Gilmar derruba direito de resposta de Moro e libera propaganda de Sandro Alex sobre aborto

en.title: Gilmar overturns Moro's right of response and allows Sandro Alex propaganda about abortion
en.summary: Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes revoked Moro's right of response against Sandro Alex campaign advertisements, allowing previously blocked materials featuring Moro's doctoral thesis on abortion to resume circulation.

stories.title: Como a IA pode ajudar a reduzir filas para consultas, exames e cirurgias na saúde

en.title: How AI can help reduce waiting lines for consultations, exams and surgeries in healthcare
en.summary: Artificial intelligence has potential applications in reducing patient wait times for medical consultations, diagnostic exams, and surgical procedures within healthcare systems.

stories.title: Próximo presidente terá de cuidar mais das contas públicas, dizem CEOs da Faria Lima

en.title: Next president will have to pay more attention to public finances, say CEOs from Faria Lima
en.summary: Business executives from São Paulo's financial district emphasize that the incoming president must prioritize management of public accounts and fiscal responsibility.

stories.title: Saúde, segurança e infraestrutura dominam campanha ao Governo do RN, que chega à reta final com mudanças na disputa

en.title: Health, security and infrastructure dominate campaign for Rio Grande do Norte government, which reaches final stretch with changes in the race
en.summary: The Rio Grande do Norte gubernatorial campaign enters its final weekend with candidates focusing on health, security, infrastructure, education and economic development, while presidential issues have also become part of candidate debates.

stories.title: Como saúde, segurança e ataques sobre corrupção foram centro da campanha para governo em MS

en.title: How health, security and corruption attacks were the center of the campaign for government in MS
en.summary: The 2026 election campaign for Mato Grosso do Sul's governorship centered on public management debates, with health, public security, anti-corruption efforts and infrastructure as the primary campaign issues.

stories.title: Não são só as contas públicas: economistas listam desafios do próximo governo, seja ele qual for

en.title: Not just public accounts: economists list challenges for the next government, whichever it may be
en.summary: Brazil's government gross debt reaches 11 trillion reais, equivalent to 82.9% of GDP. Over 20 economists from various backgrounds identified public account balance as the primary economic challenge facing the incoming administration.

stories.title: Entenda em 8 pontos por que a eleição para o Senado é importante

en.title: Understand in 8 points why the Senate election is important
en.summary: Building a Senate majority has become a strategic objective for allies of President Lula and rival Flávio Bolsonaro, reflecting the significance of upper house control in the political landscape.

stories.title: Redes sociais, conflitos familiares e medo do resultado colocam saúde mental à prova na reta final das eleições; veja como lidar

en.title: Social media, family conflicts and fear of results test mental health in final stretch of elections; see how to cope
en.summary: Frequent exposure to news, polls and social media posts combined with family disagreements and electoral anxiety can increase stress and anguish during the final weeks of campaigning, according to specialists.

stories.title: Candidaturas de última hora em MG, embates sobre dívida do estado e filas no SUS: como foi a corrida eleitoral para governador

en.title: Last-minute candidacies in MG, clashes over state debt and SUS queues: how the gubernatorial election race unfolded
en.summary: Minas Gerais' gubernatorial campaign focused on state finances, public services quality and regional challenges, with some candidates registering near the legal deadline. Key issues included over 180 billion reais in federal debt and healthcare system problems.

stories.title: Às vésperas do 1º turno, ‘fator Renan’ abala convicções do mercado

en.title: On the eve of the first round, 'Renan factor' shakes market convictions
en.summary: Stock market enthusiasm contrasts with caution in currency and interest rate markets ahead of Brazil's presidential election first round. Underlying tensions persist despite apparent market stability in the previous trading session.

stories.title: Lula e Flávio encerram campanha com foco no Sudeste e ao lado dos candidatos ao governo em SP

en.title: Lula and Flávio end campaign focused on Southeast and alongside gubernatorial candidates in SP
en.summary: The two leading presidential candidates conclude their campaigns in São Paulo on the final day before the first round. Lula plans a walk on Avenida Paulista while Flávio Bolsonaro organizes a motorcycle rally, with additional events in Rio de Janeiro.

stories.title: Quando começa a campanha eleitoral para o segundo turno?

en.title: When does the electoral campaign for the second round begin?
en.summary: Campaign for Brazil's 2026 runoff election runs from October 5 to 24, with voting scheduled for October 25. The second round applies only to executive positions requiring over 50 percent of valid votes.

stories.title: Que horas começa a votação nas eleições 2026? Veja o horário

en.title: What time does voting begin in the 2026 elections? See the schedule
en.summary: Voting in Brazil's 2026 elections runs from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. Brasília time, with adjusted hours for states in different time zones including Acre, Amazonas, Mato Grosso, and others.

stories.title: Veja quem criou o Bolsa Família, o Pix, o SUS e outros serviços e programas do governo federal

en.title: See who created Bolsa Família, Pix, SUS and other federal government services and programs
en.summary: As Brazil's 2026 presidential election approaches, candidates are claiming credit for various social programs and government services. Google Trends data shows increased searches about the origins of programs like Bolsa Família, Prouni, SUS, Minha Casa Minha Vida, and Pix.
